# Calculate annual average CPI-U for 1960, 1961, 1962

# 1960 monthly data
cpi_1960 = [29.370, 29.410, 29.410, 29.540, 29.570, 29.610, 29.550, 29.610, 29.610, 29.750, 29.780, 29.810]
avg_1960 = sum(cpi_1960) / len(cpi_1960)
print(f"1960 average: {avg_1960}")

# 1961 monthly data
cpi_1961 = [29.840, 29.840, 29.840, 29.810, 29.840, 29.840, 29.920, 29.940, 29.980, 29.980, 29.980, 30.010]
avg_1961 = sum(cpi_1961) / len(cpi_1961)
print(f"1961 average: {avg_1961}")

# 1962 monthly data
cpi_1962 = [30.040, 30.110, 30.170, 30.210, 30.240, 30.210, 30.220, 30.280, 30.420, 30.380, 30.380, 30.380]
avg_1962 = sum(cpi_1962) / len(cpi_1962)
print(f"1962 average: {avg_1962}")

# Public debt outstanding from Treasury Bulletin (public debt securities)
debt_1960 = 231015  # millions
debt_1961 = 232731  # millions
debt_1962 = 241109  # millions

# Adjust to 1962 dollars using formula: adjusted = nominal * (CPI_1962 / CPI_original)
adjusted_1960 = debt_1960 * (avg_1962 / avg_1960)
adjusted_1961 = debt_1961 * (avg_1962 / avg_1961)

print(f"\nAdjusted 1960 to 1962 dollars: {adjusted_1960}")
print(f"Adjusted 1961 to 1962 dollars: {adjusted_1961}")

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(adjusted_1961 - adjusted_1960)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {diff}")

# Round to thousandths place
diff_rounded = round(diff, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {diff_rounded}")
EOF
